summary: Three mode cards (Chat, Code, Ultracode) on one canvas; the selected card gets an aurora and a comet on its border. Form-associated.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected mode. Observed and reflected. An unknown value on connect selects `code`; unknown values set later are ignored.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Presence attribute. Disables the cards; a disabled ancestor `<fieldset>` does the same.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the user selects a different card. Not fired for programmatic changes.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Selected mode id. Setting it writes the attribute.

keyboard.action: Select and focus the next card, wrapping.
Select and focus the previous card, wrapping.

accessibility: Each card is a native button with `role="radio"` and `aria-checked`; only the selected card is in the tab order.
Card titles and descriptions are text; the canvas only draws decoration and is `aria-hidden`.
motion: With reduced motion the selection switches without fading, the border comet is off, the aurora and twinkles are drawn once without moving, and picking Ultracode throws no sparks.
form: Submits the selected mode id under `name`. No validation. Form reset returns to the mode selected on the first connect; `disabled` or a disabled fieldset disables the cards.
notes: The three modes, their descriptions and the `New` badge on Ultracode are built in and cannot be configured.
Cards sit in an auto-fit grid with a 150px minimum column width.
